failure_modes.name: Incomplete issue localization and scope control
failure_modes.description: The system can fail to identify all relevant files or the precise behavioral contract, leading to unresolved patches on repository-specific issues.

failure_modes.name: Insufficient framework-specific diagnosis
failure_modes.description: Multi-agent analysis and historical guidance do not reliably produce a sound explanation for harder Django and Sphinx behaviors, resulting in incorrect or incomplete fixes.

failure_modes.name: Weak implementation validation and iteration
failure_modes.description: The default workflow does not consistently catch failed assumptions through tests, focused reproduction, or follow-up edits; this is reflected by unresolved outcomes despite the available repository and editing tools.

why: The two resolved probes show that the default multi-agent workflow can produce effective repository-level repairs, but the two unresolved probes demonstrate substantial brittleness on more difficult instances. Scores are therefore kept materially below 1.0 and calibrated to the reported 74.6% Pass@1 rate, with execution accuracy weakest because successful analysis does not consistently translate into a validated, correct patch.
